selection: first six rows of the frozen pilot100 ordinary_cot common-eligible training material, never dev/test and no replacements
candidate_rule: complete equality-bearing mathematical lines/display blocks from the existing v2 extractor; conservatively omit the last mathematical candidate and any boxed-bearing candidate
masking: delete content tokens of the top attention-density prior unit; length/kind-matched random deletion outside that unit
ranking: uncalibrated equal-weight sum of within-question average percentile ranks of mean NLL and signed mask excess; tie by original step order; abstain if any candidate lacks controls
